interpretation: The top-level Mapping prevented assignment through the view itself but returned nested objects by reference.
All modules in a wave received views backed by the same snapshot, so one module could change another module's inputs without proposing a write.
The canonical nested field stayed unchanged, making the covert causal influence invisible in the recorded state delta and violation counts.
claimBoundary: This reproduces an in-process module contract escape. It is not evidence of operating-system process isolation failure or remote code execution.
